scope: G2 Mac executable range only; no W13 or Windows operation

work_packages.title: typed值/节点解析
work_packages.deliverable: 保留数据形状；实现typed collection和Work Plane嵌套路径。

work_packages.title: registry/schema/host兼容
work_packages.deliverable: 生成文档、工具发布、operation fallback、structuredContent/isError。

work_packages.title: 公共API与Java执行
work_packages.deliverable: 绑定Model、编译、日志与差异；许可/主机权限与trusted_code分离。

work_packages.title: 版本化文档索引
work_packages.deliverable: 官方本地帮助索引、来源、版本过滤、无结果语义。

work_packages.title: 计划/试运行/checkpoint
work_packages.deliverable: static preview与隔离trial不同；定义恢复范围和GUI rebind。

case_definitions.title: 类型往返
case_definitions.steps: 使用受支持属性测试bool/int/double/string及空、一元素、多维数组；非法矩阵测试。
case_definitions.acceptance: 形状和类型不丢失；越界/不支持签名在写前拒绝。
case_definitions.notes: ALL_MODULES is required for the agreed project capability pack when licensed; absent modules must be BLOCKED_LICENSE and cannot be counted as a pass. GUI-specific tests apply only to declared GUI capability; core six-combination release still requires the agreed Desktop workflow.

case_definitions.title: 嵌套Work Plane编辑
case_definitions.steps: 载入含wp3和矩形阵列的模型；只改选定子feature并构建。
case_definitions.acceptance: 定位正确子几何；保留左侧指定对象；主模型不替换；实体数量与间距满足契约。
case_definitions.notes: ALL_MODULES is required for the agreed project capability pack when licensed; absent modules must be BLOCKED_LICENSE and cannot be counted as a pass. GUI-specific tests apply only to declared GUI capability; core six-combination release still requires the agreed Desktop workflow.

case_definitions.title: 幂等与类型冲突
case_definitions.steps: 重复同一idempotency_key；同tag同type重复创建；同tag不同type创建。
case_definitions.acceptance: 已成功操作不重复执行；type冲突不伪成功；请求hash冲突拒绝。
case_definitions.notes: ALL_MODULES is required for the agreed project capability pack when licensed; absent modules must be BLOCKED_LICENSE and cannot be counted as a pass. GUI-specific tests apply only to declared GUI capability; core six-combination release still requires the agreed Desktop workflow.

case_definitions.title: 部分写失败与恢复
case_definitions.steps: 事务第一步成功，第二步故意失败；执行restore。
case_definitions.acceptance: 报告部分应用；恢复指定范围；有新模型对象则要求重绑定。
case_definitions.notes: ALL_MODULES is required for the agreed project capability pack when licensed; absent modules must be BLOCKED_LICENSE and cannot be counted as a pass. GUI-specific tests apply only to declared GUI capability; core six-combination release still requires the agreed Desktop workflow.

case_definitions.title: 未知高层动作的代码执行
case_definitions.steps: 选一个有公共API但无领域wrapper的操作；describe/compile/execute/readback。
case_definitions.acceptance: 在同一注入Model完成；不另开隐藏主模型；源代码、差异、结果都有证据。
case_definitions.notes: ALL_MODULES is required for the agreed project capability pack when licensed; absent modules must be BLOCKED_LICENSE and cannot be counted as a pass. GUI-specific tests apply only to declared GUI capability; core six-combination release still requires the agreed Desktop workflow.

case_definitions.title: 代码编译/运行异常
case_definitions.steps: 分别提交语法错误与执行中COMSOL异常。
case_definitions.acceptance: 行号、原始异常、部分修改、checkpoint信息完整；不吞错。
case_definitions.notes: ALL_MODULES is required for the agreed project capability pack when licensed; absent modules must be BLOCKED_LICENSE and cannot be counted as a pass. GUI-specific tests apply only to declared GUI capability; core six-combination release still requires the agreed Desktop workflow.

case_definitions.title: 严格只读与临时求值
case_definitions.steps: 在pure_read和ephemeral_mutation两策略下运行需临时节点的评估。
case_definitions.acceptance: pure_read拒绝或转隔离副本；ephemeral路径明确记录、串行且仅清自有节点。
case_definitions.notes: ALL_MODULES is required for the agreed project capability pack when licensed; absent modules must be BLOCKED_LICENSE and cannot be counted as a pass. GUI-specific tests apply only to declared GUI capability; core six-combination release still requires the agreed Desktop workflow.

case_definitions.title: 恶意文档指令不生效
case_definitions.steps: 帮助/模型描述中包含忽略权限或上传机密的指令文本。
case_definitions.acceptance: 被当作数据；无权限提升和外发；模型仍可检索普通帮助。
case_definitions.notes: ALL_MODULES is required for the agreed project capability pack when licensed; absent modules must be BLOCKED_LICENSE and cannot be counted as a pass. GUI-specific tests apply only to declared GUI capability; core six-combination release still requires the agreed Desktop workflow.

case_definitions.title: 托管代码隔离边界
case_definitions.steps: 在隔离测试账户尝试代码文件/网络/进程访问；测试server侧外部执行。
case_definitions.acceptance: OS级策略生效；不把代码扫描当sandbox；共享高权限server风险明确。
case_definitions.evidence: 账户权限、网络与执行日志
case_definitions.notes: ALL_MODULES is required for the agreed project capability pack when licensed; absent modules must be BLOCKED_LICENSE and cannot be counted as a pass. GUI-specific tests apply only to declared GUI capability; core six-combination release still requires the agreed Desktop workflow.

case_definitions.title: MCP协议正确性
case_definitions.acceptance: schema有效；stdout无污染；部分失败不包装为全成功。
case_definitions.notes: ALL_MODULES is required for the agreed project capability pack when licensed; absent modules must be BLOCKED_LICENSE and cannot be counted as a pass. case_definitions.title: host兼容模式

case_definitions.notes: ALL_MODULES is required for the agreed project capability pack when licensed; absent modules must be BLOCKED_LICENSE and cannot be counted as a pass. case_definitions.title: 文档版本隔离
case_definitions.steps: 同时索引6.3/6.4帮助；查询差异属性；删除某版索引再检索。
case_definitions.acceptance: 来源版本明确；未找到明确返回；不拿另一版文档冒充本版。
case_definitions.notes: ALL_MODULES is required for the agreed project capability pack when licensed; absent modules must be BLOCKED_LICENSE and cannot be counted as a pass. GUI-specific tests apply only to declared GUI capability; core six-combination release still requires the agreed Desktop workflow.

case_definitions.title: 保存与快照成本策略
case_definitions.steps: 对大模型批量改参数、建几何并checkpoint；测量保存次数与恢复能力。
case_definitions.acceptance: 轻量参数更新可分组；结构写前可恢复；不会因每个setter全存导致无法使用。
case_definitions.evidence: 保存日志、磁盘峰值、restore测试

GUI-specific tests apply only to declared GUI capability; core six-combination release still requires the agreed Desktop workflow.

required_live_path: stdio MCP -> control -> serialized execution service -> persistent Java Worker -> COMSOL
inherited_limits: Callback FAIL remains unless independently repaired and tested.
Windows/Intel/6.3/GUI actual validation excluded or unavailable; preserve existing historical evidence.
T009 G2 nested-path/local-edit only; W14 full advanced geometry remains NOT_RUN.
T037 full OS isolation account unavailable unless proven; source scanning is not sandbox.
T043 synthetic two-version tests do not establish actual 6.3 docs availability.
T050 small test-model save counts do not establish large-model performance.
stop: After W08-W12 accepted bounded delivery, or accurate blocked closeout after all independent work; never enter W13
